conformal.method: walk-forward split conformal (CQR), calibrated on all earlier weeks

pre_auction.description: Same walk-forward, but with the strictly pre-auction feature set: no input is dated on the delivery day (SMARD publishes its generation forecast for day D only 17-21 UTC on D-1, after the 12:00 auction). *_gate_closure models use the TSO forecast for day D, as a trader with TSO feeds would have it at 12:00.

eval.finding: LightGBM beats the naive baseline by +35.8% (MAE 19.65 EUR/MWh). A per-hour ridge (LEAR-style) baseline scores MAE 22.66. Assumes the TSOs' day-ahead generation forecast is known at gate closure; on strictly pre-auction SMARD inputs the model scores MAE 25.24. The raw p10-p90 band covers 62% of outcomes (target 80%); conformal calibration brings it to 75%. Metrics are walk-forward over the full eval period including nights and weekends.

definitions.volatile days: days whose intraday price spread is in the top decile of the eval period
